title: 冷却器
abstract: 本发明提供一种能够抑制冷却性能降低的冷却器。冷却器具有壳体构件，该壳体构件具备：制冷剂的流入口；所述制冷剂的流出口；第一构件，其包括接受来自被冷却体的热的第一面和所述第一面的相反侧的第二面；第二构件，其具有与所述第二面相对的第三面；多个突起，其从所述第三面朝向所述第二面突出；以及至少一个壁部，其与所述多个突起中的至少一个突起对应地配置，从所述第三面朝向所述第二面突出，所述至少一个壁部的突出高度比所述至少一个突起的突出高度低，所述至少一个壁部与所述至少一个突起分开，配置于所述至少一个突起的与所述流入口相反的一侧。

title: EMC壳体
abstract: 本公开提供EMC壳体。一种电磁兼容(EMC)壳体，具有用于在装配在一起时形成壳体的第一部分(2)和第二部分(3)。第一部分(2)和第二部分(3)分别包括第一接口表面(4)和第二接口表面(5)，用于当第一部分和第二部分装配在一起时压缩插入接口表面(4、5)之间的衬垫(9)。第一接口表面(4)和第二接口表面(5)中的至少一个包括多个底切区域(7)，底切区域用于当第一部分(2)和第二部分(3)装配在一起时减小衬垫(9)在该区域中的压缩。

title: 柔性可拉伸电路及其制备方法、电子设备
abstract: 本申请涉及一种柔性可拉伸电路及其制备方法、电子设备，柔性可拉伸电路包括柔性可拉伸衬底、导线单元、多个元器件和封装体；导线单元包括中间导线、均与中间导线连接的正极导线和负极导线，中间导线包括多个均呈蛇形设置的第一导线和第二导线，第一导线和第二导线交叉且连接围合成多个阵列分布的空白区域，多个第一导线间断形成连接区域；元器件与连接区域一一对应，与第一导线连接；封装体设置于柔性可拉伸衬底上，导线单元和各元器件包覆于封装体内。电路在拉伸时，第一导线和/或第二导线拉伸变形以具备较长的走线长度，但横截面积不发生变化，使得电路电阻阻值可保持稳定，能够实现小尺寸电路在弯曲拉伸时元器件的正常工作。

title: 扬声器装置
abstract: 本申请提供了一种扬声器装置，其包括：壳体、扬声器组件、散热器和导流部。扬声器组件设置于壳体。散热器设置于壳体，散热器邻近于扬声器组件。导流部设置于壳体，导流部绕扬声器组件和散热器设置，扬声器组件振动发声时所产生的气流经导流部导流至散热器。本申请解决了现有的扬声器装置存在散热速度低的问题。

title: 电子设备、分色结构件及其制备方法
abstract: 本申请涉及电子设备技术领域，提供了一种电子设备、分色结构件及其制备方法。所述电子设备至少包括TP装饰件和后盖，TP装饰件和后盖的至少一个为分色结构件，分色结构件包括结构件基材，以及结合在结构件基材上的涂层叠层，且涂层叠层至少包括设置在结构件基材不同区域表面的第一涂层叠层和第二涂层叠层，第一涂层叠层呈现第一颜色，第二涂层叠层呈现第二颜色或第二涂层叠层为透明叠层。本申请提供的电子设备，TP装饰件和后盖的至少一个为分色结构件。通过在电子设备的TP装饰件和/或后盖的不同区域设置呈现不同颜色的涂层叠层，实现TP装饰件和/或后盖的分色，使电子设备在外观上呈现视觉效果更好的颜色分布，提高电子设备的精致度要求。

title: 用于用电负载的控制设备、操作方法和控制柜
abstract: 本公开涉及一种用于用电负载的控制设备，包括：固定地布置的固定模块，其中，所述固定模块中布置有备份单元；能够替换的活动模块，所述活动模块被配置为基于存储在所述活动模块中的第一运行数据执行对所述用电负载的控制，以及周期性地将所述第一运行数据备份到所述备份单元以作为第二运行数据。本公开还涉及一种用于用电负载的控制设备的操作方法和一种用于用电负载的控制柜。

title: 布线电路基板以及布线电路基板集合体片
abstract: 在布线电路基板安装有电气元件。布线电路基板具有支承体。支承体具有上表面和下表面。在支承体形成有沿厚度方向延伸的第一贯通孔。另外，布线电路基板具有对支承体的外表面进行覆盖的绝缘层。绝缘层中的对第一贯通孔的内周面进行覆盖的部分形成在第一贯通孔的内部沿厚度方向延伸的第二贯通孔。第二贯通孔形成为能够收容电气元件的至少一部分。以从第二贯通孔的内周面向绝缘层的上表面以及下表面延伸的方式，以给定图案形成有第一导体层以及第二导体层。

title: 一种连接机构、安装组件及机柜
abstract: 本发明公开了一种连接机构、安装组件及机柜，连接机构用于连接柜体和安装模块，连接机构包括连接件和弹性件，每个连接件设有固定部和连接部，各固定部固接于安装模块，连接部设有拉手并适于绕垂直于第二方向的第一轴线转动于第一位置和第二位置之间；在第一位置，连接部适于抵接柜体的前表面并与其固接；在第二位置，拉手适于牵引安装模块；弹性件适于使拉手保持在第二位置。安装组件包括安装模块和上述连接机构。机柜包括柜体和上述安装组件。本发明的连接机构、安装组件及机柜，可充分利用柜体内部空间并减小柜体的占地面积，安装模块的维护便捷且其正面可预留出更多的器件摆放空间，整体更为美观，尤其适用于结构紧凑的安装模块和柜体。

title: 一种大功率且高效的循环液冷却器
abstract: 本发明公开了一种大功率且高效的循环液冷却器，属于循环液冷却器技术领域，该大功率且高效的循环液冷却器，包括外壳，所述外壳内部为空心结构设置，所述外壳内部设置有流体优化组件，用于提升散热效果、减少局部过热和积尘，还能优化流体动力学、提高系统的稳定性，且外壳顶部的液体存放腔内设置有双向扰流组件，用于减小热边界层，增强流体混合，优化冷却系统的动态响应。本发明通过采用双向扰流组件和流体优化组件，使得散热器的上下左右运动和双向扰动冷却液，能显著提升冷却系统的热交换效率、冷却液流动性、系统响应速度和整体稳定性，不仅减少热边界层、提高热交换效率，还能减少能耗，延长设备寿命，降低维护频率。

title: SEMICONDUCTOR CORE LAYER INCLUDING GLASS SHEET HAVING EDGE SEALANT STRUCTURE AND METHOD OF MAKING SAME
abstract: A package substrate includes: a sheet including glass; build-up layers respectively on a top surface and on a bottom surface of the sheet; structures defining electrically conductive pathways within the sheet and within the build-up layers; and a ribbon-shaped edge structure in recesses defined at lateral edges of the sheet and defined with respect to lateral edges of the build-up layers, the ribbon-shaped edge structure extending in a direction along a thickness of the sheet, having a lateral edge surface facing away from the sheet, and comprising an edge structure material not including glass and not including metal.

title: LED LAMP BEAD AND PHOTOGRAPHIC AND VIDEOGRAPHIC LAMP
abstract: An LED lamp bead includes a substrate, a chip, and signal pin groups. The chip is arranged on the substrate. Each signal pin group includes, electrically connected to the chip, signal input ends and signal output ends. The signal pin groups are arranged on peripheral side edges of the substrate, and at least two side edges of the substrate are both provided with the signal pin groups.

title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE COMPRISING HEAT DISSIPATION STRUCTURE
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a first support member partially including a thermally conductive material, a printed circuit board arranged to face the first support member, an integrated circuit chip arranged between the first support member and the printed circuit board, arranged on one surface of the printed circuit board, a solid-state thermal interface material (TIM) with compressibility, of which a portion of one surface is in contact with the integrated circuit chip and a portion of the other surface is in contact with the first support member, to transfer heat between the integrated circuit chip and the first support member, and a shielding film which is arranged between the TIM and the first support member and partially attached to the TIM and provides a first opening allowing a portion of the other surface of the TIM to be attached to the first support member.

title: KÜHLSYSTEM
abstract: Ein Kühlsystem umfasst eine Kühleinheit, die so konfiguriert ist, dass sie eine Vielzahl von Kühleinrichtungen aufweist, die einen wärmeerzeugenden Körper kühlen, einen einlassseitigen Verteiler, der ein Kältemittel an die Kühleinrichtungen verteilt, und einen auslassseitigen Verteiler, aus dem das Kältemittel von jeder der Kühleinrichtungen abgegeben wird, einen natürliche Zirkulationsabschnitt, der so konfiguriert ist, dass er eine Naturzirkulationsleitung aufweist, die den auslassseitigen Verteiler und den einlassseitigen Verteiler verbindet, und einen ersten Wärmetauscher, der in einer Mitte der Naturzirkulationsleitung und oberhalb der Kühleinheit installiert ist, und einen Zwangszirkulationsabschnitt, der so konfiguriert ist, dass er eine Zwangszirkulationsleitung aufweist, die den auslassseitigen Verteiler und den einlassseitigen Verteiler verbindet, einen zweiten Wärmetauscher, der in einer Mitte der Zwangszirkulationsleitung vorgesehen ist und eine größere Kapazität als der erste Wärmetauscher aufweist, und eine Pumpe, die in der Zwangszirkulationsleitung vorgesehen ist, um das Kältemittel von dem auslassseitigen Verteiler zu dem einlassseitigen Verteiler zu pumpen.

title: KÜHLER
abstract: Ein Kühler beinhaltet ein Gehäuse, beinhaltend: einen Einlass für ein Kältemittel; einen Auslass für das Kältemittel; ein erstes Element mit einer ersten Oberfläche, die Wärme von einem gekühlten Körper absorbiert, und einer zweiten Oberfläche entgegengesetzt zu der ersten Oberfläche; ein zweites Element mit einer dritten Oberfläche, die der zweiten Oberfläche zugewandt ist; Erhebungen, die sich von der dritten Oberfläche zu der zweiten Oberfläche erstrecken; und mindestens eine Ablenkplatte bzw. ein Leitblech, das für mindestens eine Erhebung von den Erhebungen angeordnet ist und sich von der dritten Oberfläche zu der zweiten Oberfläche erstreckt. Das mindestens eine Leitblech weist eine vorstehende Höhe auf, die kleiner als eine vorstehende Höhe der mindestens einen Erhebung ist. Das mindestens eine Leitblech ist von der mindestens einen Erhebung beabstandet und ist an einer Seite entgegengesetzt zu dem Einlass relativ zu der mindestens einen Erhebung angeordnet.

title: Kühlmittelsystem
abstract: In einer beispielhaften Ausführungsform wird ein Kühlmittelsystem bereitgestellt, das einen oder mehrere Verbindungsstücke und eine Vielzahl von eingesetzten Vorrichtungen umfasst. Das eine oder die mehreren Verbindungsstücke sind jeweils konfiguriert, den Fluss von Kühlmittelfluid des Kühlmittelsystems zu ermöglichen, und jedes umfasst eine Basis und eine Vielzahl von Anschlüssen. Die Basis definiert Fluid-Durchgänge darin. Die Vielzahl von Anschlüssen sind mit den Fluid-Durchgängen gekoppelt, und konfiguriert, den Fluss des Kühlmittelfluids dorthindurch zu erlauben. Jeder der Anschlüsse umfasst einen drehbaren Kopf und eine Vielzahl von Anschlägen. Die Vielzahl von eingesetzten Vorrichtungen weisen jeweils entsprechende Gegenstücke auf und werden jeweils innerhalb eines entsprechenden der Anschlüsse in einem Winkel eingesetzt, der basierend auf einem Eingriff der entsprechenden Gegenstücke mit einem oder mehreren der Vielzahl von Anschlägen des drehbaren Kopfes des entsprechenden Anschlusses bestimmt wird.

title: Stromrichter
abstract: Stromrichter (100), umfassend:eine Platte (1);ein Heizelement (2), das mit der Platte (1) verbunden ist, und Stromumwandlung durchführt;ein Gehäuse (3), das einen konvexen Radiator (35) enthält, der Wärme von dem Heizelement (2) abstrahlt und zu der Platte (1) vorsteht, und in dem die Platte (1) und das Heizelement (2) angeordnet sind; undein Presselement (6), das zwischen der Platte (1) und einer Bodenfläche (32) des Gehäuses (3) angeordnet ist und das Heizelement (2) zu einer ersten Seitenfläche (35a) des konvexen Radiators (35) des Gehäuses (3) presst;wobei das Presselement (6) an dem Gehäuse (3) durch Befestigen eines ersten Befestigungselements (12) in einer Befestigungsrichtung entlang einer Richtung entgegen einer Vorstehrichtung des konvexen Radiators (35) fixiert wird;wobei das Gehäuse (3) eine Innenseitenfläche (3a) aufweist, die der ersten Seitenfläche (35a) zugewandt ist; undwobei die Innenseitenfläche (3a) eine Führung (8) enthält, die so konfiguriert ist, dass sie das Presselement (6) entlang der Richtung entgegen der Vorstehrichtung des konvexen Radiators (35) führt.

title: GUIDE COMPONENT
abstract: A guide component has a base formed with an accommodation portion. The accommodation portion has two first sides each extending along a first horizontal direction and two second sides each extending along a second horizontal direction. The accommodation portion is provided with a first press-fit projection projecting inward in the horizontal plane from the first side and a second press-fit projection projecting inward in the horizontal plane from the second side. Under an attached state where the guide component is attached to a connector, the connector is located in the accommodation portion, is pressed against the first press-fit projection in the second horizontal direction and is pressed against the second press-fit projection in the first horizontal direction.

title: PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD AND METHOD OF MANUFACTURING THE SAME
abstract: A printed circuit board includes a first build-up insulating layer; an interconnect structure buried in an upper side of the first build-up insulating layer and including one or more insulating layers, one or more wiring layers, and one or more via layers; an adhesive disposed between an upper surface of the first build-up insulating layer and an upper surface of the interconnect structure, and having an upper surface exposed from the upper surface of the first build-up insulating layer; and a metal bump including a via portion penetrating the adhesive and a protrusion protruding to the upper surface of the adhesive.

title: 電力変換装置、部品間接続システム及び部品間接続方法
ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING TECHNIQUES FOR PRODUCING A NETWORK OF CONDUCTIVE PATHWAYS ON A SUBSTRATE
abstract: The disclosed embodiments include an automobile panel that can include a polymer substrate, a network of conductive pathways, and connectors coupled to ends of the network of conductive pathways. The network of conductive pathways can include conductive material disposed in cavities forming a network of channels in the polymer substrate. The conductive material at least partially encapsulates by the polymer substrate. The connectors are connectable to automotive electronic devices thereby forming electrical circuits that include the network of conductive pathways and the automotive electronics.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM OF MANUFACTURING PRINTED WIRING BOARD
abstract: A method of manufacturing a printed wiring board according to one aspect of the present disclosure is a method of manufacturing a printed wiring board from a printed wiring board sheet having a plurality of printed wiring board pieces. The method includes: determining, by an electrical inspection, whether each of the plurality of printed wiring board pieces is a non-defective product or a defective product; after the determining, selectively cutting out the non-defective product from the printed wiring board sheet; and inspecting an appearance of the non-defective product cut out in the cutting out. The method further includes passing on data about a non-defective product or a defective product to the cutting out, the data about a non-defective product or a defective product being obtained in the determining. In the cutting out, the non-defective product is cut out based on the data passed on in the passing on.

title: PROTECTIVE BOOT FOR AN ELECTRONIC DEVICE
abstract: A protective boot for an electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device comprises a guide rail on the side of the electronic device. The protective boot comprises a rim that is configured to extend around a periphery of the electronic device, a strap portion that comprises a first portion that extends from the rim, and a bottom portion that defines a cut-out relative to the first portion of the strap portion. Further, the cut-out is configured to allow the guide rail of the electronic device to mate with a corresponding feature of a charging base when the rim of the protective boot extends around the periphery of the electronic device.

title: BAFFLE FOR AN INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE
abstract: A baffle to restrain a flow of fluid to a fluid flow path defined in an information processing device is disclosed. The baffle includes a fixed end, a free end opposite to the fixed end, the attachment portion, and a finger portion. The attachment portion is at the fixed end and includes a mechanical mounting member. The mechanical mounting member is configured to detachably couple to a support structure of the information processing device so as to mount the attachment portion to the information processing device. The finger portion includes a plurality of flaps extending from the attachment portion to the free end and configured to restrain the flow of the fluid to the fluid flow path. The finger portion includes a compliant material such as one of a rubber material or a silicon material.

title: REPLACEABLE PUMP UNIT FOR COOLING SYSTEMS
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for a high density liquid cooling unit to cool electrical components. A replaceable pump unit (RPU) can include a pump configured to provide fluid flow to cool the electrical components (e.g., via direct liquid cooling of the electrical components by the pumped fluid and air-to-liquid cooling of the pumped fluid via a heat exchanger in fluid communication with the RPU). The RPU can be configured to be operated with or satisfy one or more RPU performance characteristics.

title: 車両
A POWER CONVERTER ASSEMBLY WITH THERMAL GUIDE LAYER
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a power converter assembly comprising: an integrated power stage comprising one or more power management integrated circuits and one or more switches; a thermal guide layer arranged on top of the integrated power stage, the thermal guide layer comprising a silicon substrate portion; a layer of an electrically isolative portion deposited on a top side and a bottom side of the silicon substrate portion; bottom layer connector portions made of an electrically conductive material deposited on the electrically isolative portion; top layer connector portions made of an electrically conductive material deposited on the electrically isolative portion; through-silicon vias connecting the bottom layer connector portions and the top layer connector portions; one or more passive components arranged on the thermal guide layer, wherein the one or more passive components are connected to the top layer connector portions of the thermal guide layer, wherein the one or more power management integrated circuits, the one or more switches and the one or more passive components are configured to perform a power conversion of an input voltage and/or current to an output voltage and/or current.

title: Foldable Electronic Device
abstract: A foldable electronic device includes a hinge structure, a first middle frame, and a second middle frame. An end portion of the hinge structure includes a blocking member, and along an axial direction of the hinge structure, the blocking member includes a first side surface and a second side surface that face away from each other. The first side surface faces the display, and the second side surface faces away from the display.

title: COOLING APPARATUS FOR POWER MODULES
abstract: The cooling of power modules used in high-power systems, such as three-phase inverters, may require a cooling apparatus that is heavier than desired for some applications, such as electric vehicles. A cooling apparatus is disclosed that can provide sufficient cooling in a weight-reduced package. Additionally, assembly methods are disclosed that make the cooling apparatus more robust to shocks and vibrations, which may be experienced by electric vehicles.

title: PRECISE AND EFFICIENT COOLING SYSTEM CONTROL
abstract: A cooling system can include a first loop disposed at least partially within a space, such as a data center, a second loop disposed at least partially outside the space, and a heat exchanger for transferring heat from the first loop to the second loop. The first loop can include an evaporator for transferring heat from within the space to a first cooling fluid, and a prime mover for circulating the first cooling fluid within the first loop. The heat exchanger can transfer heat from the first cooling fluid to a second cooling fluid. The second loop can include a condenser for transferring heat from the second cooling fluid to an environment outside the space. The condenser can be disposed at a higher elevation than the heat exchanger and the second loop can operate as a thermosiphon.

title: Power Module Having Features for Minimizing Baseplate Movement
abstract: A power module includes a baseplate and an enclosure. The baseplate includes a first surface with a plurality of openings. The enclosure includes a first surface that faces the first surface of the baseplate and a plurality of posts jutting out from the first surface. Each of the posts of the enclosure is inserted into a respective opening of the baseplate. A first post of the enclosure is inserted into a first opening of the baseplate and is configured to minimize lateral movement of the baseplate relative to the enclosure. A second post of the enclosure is inserted into a second opening of the baseplate and is configured to minimize rotational movement of the baseplate about the first post.

title: CERAMIC SUBSTRATE AND ELECTRONIC COMPONENT
abstract: A ceramic substrate that includes: a base body including a ceramic layer; at least one inner conductor in the base body; a terminal electrode including a first electrode in contact with an outer surface of the base body and a second electrode covering a surface of the first electrode; and an insulating layer covering at least a portion of an outer periphery of the first electrode, the ceramic substrate including a section where the first electrode, the insulating layer, and the second electrode overlap in a thickness direction, the first electrode having a non-conductive component content of from 3% by weight to 40% by weight, the second electrode having a non-conductive component content of from 0% by weight to 10% by weight, and the non-conductive component content of the first electrode being equal to or greater than the non-conductive component content of the second electrode.

title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE AND NOISE CONTROL METHOD
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a slidable housing including a first housing and a second housing, a first substrate included in the first housing and including a processor, a second substrate included in the second housing, a flexible printed circuit board (FPCB) which includes a ground line, electrically connects the first substrate and the second substrate to each other, and has a shape changed according to the movement of the slidable housing, and a matching circuit electrically connecting the first substrate and at least a portion of the ground line of the FPCB, and changing impedance under the control of the at least one processor according to the shape of the FPCB.

title: Anzeigevorrichtung und elektronisches Gerät
abstract: Anzeigevorrichtung, die ein erstes Anzeigefeld (100a) und ein zweites Anzeigefeld (100b) umfasst,wobei das erste Anzeigefeld (100a) einen ersten Anzeigebereich (101a) umfasst,wobei das zweite Anzeigefeld (100b) einen zweiten Anzeigebereich (101b) und einen Bereich (110b) umfasst, der sichtbares Licht durchlässt,wobei der zweite Anzeigebereich (101b) dem Bereich (110b) benachbart ist, der das sichtbare Licht durchlässt,wobei der erste Anzeigebereich (101a) einen Abschnitt umfasst, der sich mit dem Bereich (110b) überlappt, der das sichtbare Licht durchlässt,wobei das erste Anzeigefeld (100a) ein erstes Licht emittierendes Element (1105R), ein zweites Licht emittierendes Element (1105G) und ein drittes Licht emittierendes Element (1105B) umfasst,wobei das erste Licht emittierende Element (1105R), das zweite Licht emittierende Element (1105G) und das dritte Licht emittierende Element (1105B) eine Elektronentransportschicht zwischen einem Elektrodenpaar (1101, 1102) umfassen und jeweils eine Licht emittierende Schicht zwischen dem Elektrodenpaar (1101, 1102) umfassen,wobei die Licht emittierende Schicht in dem ersten Licht emittierenden Element (1105R), die Licht emittierende Schicht in dem zweiten Licht emittierenden Element (1105G) und die Licht emittierende Schicht in dem dritten Licht emittierenden Element (1105B) voneinander getrennt sind, undwobei das erste Licht emittierende Element (1105R), das zweite Licht emittierende Element (1105G) und das dritte Licht emittierende Element (1105B) die gleiche Elektronentransportschicht gemeinsam verwenden.wobei Licht, das von dem ersten Licht emittierenden Element (1105R) emittiert wird, eine CIE-1931-Chromatizitätskoordinate x von größer als 0,680 und kleiner als oder gleich 0,720 und eine CIE-1931-Chromatizitätskoordinate y von größer als oder gleich 0,260 und kleiner als oder gleich 0,320 aufweist,wobei Licht, das von dem zweiten Licht emittierenden Element (1105G) emittiert wird, eine CIE-1931-Chromatizitätskoordinate x von größer als oder gleich 0,130 und kleiner als oder gleich 0,250 und eine CIE-1931-Chromatizitätskoordinate y von größer als 0,710 und kleiner als oder gleich 0,810 aufweist, undwobei Licht, das von dem dritten Licht emittierenden Element (1105B) emittiert wird, eine CIE-1931-Chromatizitätskoordinate x von größer als oder gleich 0,120 und kleiner als oder gleich 0,170 und eine CIE-1931-Chromatizitätskoordinate y von größer als oder gleich 0,020 und kleiner als 0,060 aufweist.

title: DYNAMIC CONTROL OF LIQUID-ASSISTED AIR COOLING SYSTEMS
abstract: An apparatus comprises a processing device configured to monitor status information for electronic equipment of an information technology asset, at least a portion of the electronic equipment being at least partially cooled by at least one pump of a liquid-assisted air cooling system. The at least one processing device is also configured to determine configuration information for at least one motor of the at least one pump of the liquid-assisted air cooling system based at least in part on the monitored status information. The at least one processing device is further configured to control operation of the at least one motor of the at least one pump of the liquid-assisted air cooling system based at least in part on the determined configuration information.

title: CABLE, DISPLAY DEVICE INCLUDING THE SAME AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING THE SAME
abstract: A display device may include: a chassis assembly; a display panel on the chassis assembly; a circuit board assembly electrically connected to the display panel; and at least one cable configured to electrically connect the display panel or the circuit board assembly, wherein the at least one cable includes: a cable body including a connection terminal; and a pair of fixing portions respectively connected to two opposite ends of the cable body and configured to be at least partially separated from the corresponding end of the cable body by cutting, and wherein each of the fixing portions includes: a fixing portion body connected to the cable body and configured to be at least partially separated from the cable body by cutting, the fixing portion body including a fixing recess; and a cutting portion including at least one perforation line extending by a predetermined distance along a connecting portion between the fixing portion body and the cable body.

title: AUTOMATIC CLEANING DEVICE, AND SYSTEM
abstract: An automatic cleaning device, includes: a mobile platform; a circuit board, which is arranged in the mobile platform and comprises a circuit board body provided with a middle area and an edge area surrounding the middle area; interface devices arranged on the circuit board body and located in the edge area; electronic devices arranged on the circuit board body and located in the middle area; and a blocking rib arranged between the interface devices and the electronic devices and configured to block liquid and/or moisture from coming into contact with the electronic devices.

title: COOLER
abstract: A cooler includes a case including: an inlet for a refrigerant; an outlet for the refrigerant; a first member with a first surface that absorbs heat from a cooled body and a second surface opposite to the first surface; a second member with a third surface facing the second surface; protrusions that extend from the third surface toward the second surface; and at least one baffle that is disposed for at least one protrusion from among the protrusions and extends from the third surface toward the second surface. The at least one baffle has a protruding height that is less than a protruding height of the at least one protrusion. The at least one baffle is spaced apart from the at least one protrusion and is disposed on a side opposite the inlet relative to the at least one protrusion.

title: MAGNETIC SNAP-ON INTELLIGENT QUICK CONNECTION SYSTEM
abstract: The present disclosure belongs to the field of mobile device mount technology, in particular to a magnetic snap-on intelligent quick connection system, comprising a device connection module including a circular base, an annular magnet array, and a quick-release fastener; the base being provided with a circular mounting slot. The present disclosure achieves great convenience by using a complete circular docking system formed by the circular base, the circular mounting slot, and the circular central hole of the device connection module, and the circular device and the frustum of the mount connection module, eliminating the need for precise angle matching during magnetic alignment. The annular magnet array and corresponding magnet groups generate uniform attraction at any angle, allowing the frustum to automatically align and insert into the central hole. Then the latches accurately dock with the snap-fit locating slots to lock in place by 360-degree arbitrary rotation.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR THERMAL CONTROL IN AN INFORMATION HANDLING SYSTEM
abstract: A method may include controlling a cooling subsystem, the cooling subsystem comprising at least one air mover configured to generate a cooling airflow in a system, based at least in part on an inlet temperature to the system when an inlet temperature sensor for sensing the inlet temperature is available and in response to a failure of the inlet temperature sensor, executing an energy balance calculation to estimate a virtual inlet temperature based on one or more temperature values from one or more temperature sensors of a plurality of temperature sensors of the system other than the inlet temperature sensor and controlling the cooling subsystem based at least in part on the virtual inlet temperature when the inlet temperature sensor is unavailable.

title: HEAT DISSIPATION DEVICE AND POWER MODULE ADAPTED THERETO
abstract: A heat dissipation device adapted to a power module includes a first plate body and a second plate body. The first plate body includes a first plate element having a first surface and a second surface opposite to each other, wherein the first surface faces toward a heat source in the power module, and the first plate element includes plural holes penetrating the first surface and the second surface. The second plate body is stacked with the first plate body and includes a second plate element and plural protruding elements. The second plate element includes a third surface and a fourth surface opposite each other, wherein the third surface is adjacent to the second surface, and the plural protruding elements are disposed on the third surface. At least a portion of the plural protruding elements penetrate in the plural holes and contact with the heat source.

title: SUSTAINABLE COATINGS ON CONDUCTIVE PARTS SUCH AS A MAGNESIUM-BASED LAPTOP CHASSIS
abstract: Disclosed herein is method for finishing a conductive part with a sustainable coating, where the part may be a magnesium-based chassis/housing for electronic equipment. The method includes depositing electrochemically a coating material onto the conductive surface of the component, placing a thin film over the coating material, and attaching the thin film onto the component by way of a vacuum transfer process. A graphite-based coating (e.g., graphene) may also be placed between the conductive surface and the thin film. The thin film may be decorative/cosmetic thin film to provide an attractive aesthetic.

title: FUNCTIONAL BOX ASSEMBLY, HEADPHONE, AND HEADPHONE SYSTEM
abstract: Provided is a functional box assembly, including a box body and a button. The box body has a control region configured for installing the button. The control region is provided with at least two button regions. The button includes at least two trigger portions corresponding to the at least two button regions. The box body and the button are connected through a spacing portion, such that the at least two trigger portions and the at least two button regions are spaced apart from each other. The spacing portion is located between two adjacent button regions of the at least two button regions. The button is rotatable around the spacing portion to bring one of the at least two trigger portions into contact with a corresponding button region of the at least two button regions.

title: HOCHLEISTUNGS-DRAHTVERBINDUNG MIT LEITERPLATTE
abstract: Eine Leiterplattenbaugruppe für ein Fahrzeuglenksystem schließt eine Leiterplatte ein. Die Leiterplattenbaugruppe schließt außerdem eine Anschlussklemme ein, die funktionell an einer Fläche der Leiterplatte angebracht ist, wobei die Anschlussklemme aus einem elastisch verformbaren Material ausgebildet ist, wobei die Anschlussklemme ein erstes Federsegment und ein zweites Federsegment einschließt. Die Leiterplattenbaugruppe schließt ferner einen Draht ein, der zwischen dem ersten Federsegment und dem zweiten Federsegment angeordnet ist und mit diesen in Kontakt steht.

title: SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a first case, a second case coupled to the first case to form an inner space, a memory module disposed within the inner space, and including a module substrate and a plurality of electronic components mounted on the module substrate, and a heat dissipation chamber assembly provided in at least a portion of the first case, and including a heat diffusion chamber in thermal contact with at least one of the electronic components and a sidewall structure extending vertically toward the module substrate to surround the electronic component in thermal contact with the heat diffusion chamber.

title: PLATE HEAT EXCHANGER WITH LIQUID BACKFLUSH CIRCUIT
abstract: In a present embodiment, a thermal cooling system can include a liquid-cooling circuit, a heat exchanger, and a liquid flush circuit. The liquid-cooling circuit can be configured to convey a cooling fluid therethrough. The heat exchanger can be fluidly coupled with the liquid-cooling circuit. The liquid flush circuit can be fluidly coupled with the liquid-cooling circuit, and the liquid flush circuit can include a filter. The liquid flush circuit can be configured to selectively operate in a normal cooling operation mode or in a flushing mode. The flushing mode can be configured to cause the cooling fluid to divert through the liquid flush circuit and the heat exchanger to cause the cooling fluid to flow through the filter after passing through the heat exchanger.

title: VOLTAGE SOURCE
abstract: A voltage source, comprising a chassis (10), and a power supply module (20) and N PCB assemblies (30) that are provided in the chassis (10). Each PCB assembly (30) comprises a control module (31), a first isolation module (32), a second isolation module (33), a third-stage filtering module (34), and a DAC and amplifier module (35), wherein the power supply module (20) is sequentially connected to the first isolation module (32), the third-stage filtering module (34) and the DAC and amplifier module (35), the power supply module (20) receives an externally input mains voltage and converts same into a direct-current power source required by the PCB assembly (30), and the third-stage filtering module (34) filters the power resource on the PCB assembly (30); and the control module (31) is sequentially connected to the second isolation module (33) and the DAC and amplifier module (35), the control module (31) communicates with the outside and transmits a control signal to the DAC and amplifier module (35) by means of the second isolation module (33), and the DAC and amplifier module (35) outputs a voltage value on the basis of the control signal. Thus, both an output voltage range and precision stability meet the requirements of superconducting quantum computing, and large-scale deployment costs are reduced.

title: ロール状ガラスクロス
Leistungselektronische Anlage
abstract: Leistungselektronische Anlage (10), gekennzeichnet durch folgende Merkmale:- die Anlage (10) umfasst einen Kühlmittelverteiler (11), einen Kühlmittelanschluss (12), elektrisch aktive Teile (13, 14), nämlich Leistungselektronik (13) und einen Anschlusskasten (14), einen gemäß der Norm für 19"-Komponenten EIA 310-D, IEC 60297 und DIN 41494 SC48D gefertigten, die aktiven Teile (13, 14) tragenden Baugruppenträger und mindestens einen am Baugruppenträger befestigten, unterhalb der Leistungselektronik (13) und des Anschlusskastens angeordneten Messfühler (15) zum Messen eines Wasserstandes innerhalb der Anlage (10),- der Kühlmittelanschluss (12) verbindet den Kühlmittelverteiler (11) fluidtechnisch mit der Leistungselektronik (13) und- die Anlage (10) ist derart konfiguriert, dass die Anlage (10) selbsttätig abschaltet und ein Backend von einem möglichen Hochwasser in Kenntnis setzt, wenn der Messfühler (15) den Wasserstand erfasst.

title: HEAT SINK UNIT, HEAT SINK ASSEMBLY AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE
abstract: A heat sink unit includes a first plate portion and a second plate portion. The first plate portion is integrally formed and includes an outer surface, an inner surface and at least one protrusion. The second plate portion is connected to the first plate portion. A first angle between the first plate portion and the second plate portion is between 5 degrees and 175 degrees. The outer surface of the first plate portion is farther from the second plate portion than the inner surface therefrom, and the protrusion is located on the outer surface.

title: フレキシブル回路基板及びそれを含むフォルダブル電子装置
SELF-EXTENDABLE INTERCONNECT STRUCTURES FOR SURFACE MOUNT SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICES
abstract: In an embodiment, a semiconductor device includes a wiring substrate. A chip, such as microchip, integrated circuit device, a semiconductor die, or the like is on a first surface of the wiring substrate. A plurality of protruding portions are on a second surface of the wiring substrate. Each protruding portion includes a solder reservoir space therein that can contain or be filled with solder so as to permit solder from the reservoir space to flow outward in a solder reflow process for bonding the semiconductor device to a circuit board or the like. The solder from the reservoir is available to compensate for differences in gap distances between the semiconductor device and a circuit board or the like that arise in the manufacturing of electronic devices when attempting to bond a semiconductor device to a circuit board. The protruding portions may comprise tubes, posts, pairs of plates, or the like.

title: BASE MATERIAL FOR MOUNTING ELECTRONIC DEVICE
abstract: A base material for mounting an electronic device, the base material including a metal foil, a hygroscopic layer, and a barrier sheet laminated in this order, in which the metal foil has a thickness of from 5 to 20 μm.

title: HYBRID-DIELEKTRIKUM-SCHEMA IN PACKAGES
abstract: Verfahren mit den folgenden Schritten:Herstellen einer ersten Umverteilungsleitung (RDL1);Herstellen einer ersten Polymerschicht (DL1) mit einem ersten Teil, der die erste Umverteilungsleitung (RDL1) umschließt, und einem zweiten Teil, der die erste Umverteilungsleitung (RDL1) überdeckt;Herstellen eines Paars Differential-Übertragungsleitungen (SL1, SL2) über und in Kontakt mit der ersten Polymerschicht (DL1);Herstellen einer zweiten Umverteilungsleitung (RDL2) zeitgleich mit dem Herstellen des Paars Differential-Übertragungsleitungen (SL1, SL2);Herstellen einer Durchkontaktierung (V3) über und in Kontakt mit der zweiten Umverteilungsleitung (RDL2);Umspritzen des Paars Differential-Übertragungsleitungen (SL1, SL2) und der Durchkontaktierung (V3) mit einer ersten Formmasse (DL2), wobei die erste Formmasse einen ersten Teil, der das Paar Differential-Übertragungsleitungen (SL1, SL2) umschließt, und einen zweiten Teil aufweist, der das Paar Differential-Übertragungsleitungen (SL1, SL2) überdeckt und die Durchkontaktierung (V3) umschließt; undDurchführen eines Planarisierungsprozesses, um Oberseiten der Durchkontaktierung (V3) und der ersten Formmasse (DL2) auf gleiche Höhe zu bringen;Herstellen eines elektrischen Verbindungselements (62) über und in elektrischer Verbindung mit dem Paar Differential-Übertragungsleitungen (SL1, SL2).

title: FAN CONTROL FOR HEADSET COMPUTING DEVICE
abstract: Circuits, methods, and apparatus that can control components of headset computing devices and other devices. An example can determine whether a headset computing device is being worn. If the headset computing device is not being worn, a fan can be stopped. If the headset computing device is being worn, a determination can be made as to whether a temperature of the headset computing device is above a first temperature. If it is, the fan can be turned on. If the temperature of the headset computing device is below the first temperature, the fan can be turned off.

title: SOCKET ASSEMBLIES FOR SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICES
abstract: Assemblies and methods of manufacturing assemblies that include sockets and packaged semiconductor chips are provided. The package substrates for the semiconductor chips can include cores that are formed from a solid amorphous glass layer. The package substrates can have gaps around sides and alignment pins in the assemblies.

title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE
abstract: An electronic device includes a first housing; a second housing including a fitting portion, and an elastic body. The first housing includes at least one fitted portion configured to be fitted to the fitting portion by being slid along a first direction, and a first housing side peripheral edge portion provided on a peripheral edge of the first housing, and the elastic body is positioned between the fitted portion and the first housing side peripheral edge portion during the fitting.

title: COMPUTER POWER CONNECTION DEVICE
abstract: A computer power connection device comprises: a 3-way connection; a DC source cable extending from a DC input plug to the 3-way connection; a DC output cable extending from the 3-way connection to a DC supply plug; a verification cable extending from the 3-way connection to a verification connector for connection to the power output of an unpowered power supply unit; a verification signal wire extending from the verification connector through the verification cable, through the DC output cable to the DC supply plug; a DC power wire extending from the DC input plug through the DC source cable, and through the DC output cable to the DC supply plug; and a ground wire through the cables connecting the DC input plug and the DC supply plug.

title: DEVICE, IN PARTICULAR SENSOR DEVICE COMPRISING A SENSOR UNIT, AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING SUCH A DEVICE
abstract: The invention relates to a device (10, 11), in particular a sensor device comprising a sensor unit (100), the device (10, 11) having a printed circuit board (20) and an electrical energy storage element (30), and a first metal welding plate (21, 23) and a second metal welding plate (22, 24) being arranged on the printed circuit board (20) and each being mechanically fixedly and electrically connected to the printed circuit board (20), and the energy storage element (30) having a first electrical connection (31) comprising a first metal connection lug (32) and having a second electrical connection (33) comprising a second metal connection lug (34), the first connection lug (32) and the second connection lug (34) being arranged and configured in such a way that the first connection lug (32) rests at least partially on the first welding plate (21, 23) and the second connection lug (34) rests at least partially on the second welding plate (22, 24) and each connection lug is cohesively connected, in particular welded, to the respective welding plate. The invention also relates to a method for producing a device (10, 11) according to the invention.

title: 吸着ノズル検査装置および吸着ノズル管理装置
SECURED CONTROL UNIT FOR A SYSTEM IN A VEHICLE
abstract: The invention relates to a secured control unit (100) for a system in a vehicle, wherein the control unit (100) comprises control electronics (110) and a housing (120) enclosing the control electronics (110), and the control electronics (110) are designed to ascertain an opening of the housing (120) and to carry out a securing function on the basis thereof.

title: CONNECTOR ASSEMBLY FOR ELECTRIC CABLES AND ELECTRIC CONNECTOR
abstract: A connector assembly for electric cables having a predetermined wire gauge to be mated with a mating connector along a mating direction includes a plurality of terminals arranged on a common terminal plane. The common terminal plane extends parallel to the mating direction. Each of the terminals is configured to be connected to at least one wire. The distances between each of the plurality of terminals in a pitch direction is smaller than the predetermined wire gauge. An electric connector including the connector assembly further includes a mating connector having a plurality of mating contacts with a mating pitch that is equal to the distance of the terminals of the connector assembly.

title: Direct Connectorization for High-Frequency Signals
abstract: Improved electrical connections to a probe head are provided by making electrical connections to a flexible circuit connected to the probes. Preferably these connections are solderless and made with a single ganged unit. Many advantages result compared to conventional approaches of making soldered connections to a flexible circuit, or coupling the flexible circuit to a printed circuit board (PCB) and making the connections from the PCB using semi-rigid coaxial cables.

title: SINGULATION INCORPORATING AN ETCHED METAL CHANNEL
abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein may include an apparatus that includes a substrate with a first edge surface. In an embodiment, the substrate may comprise a glass layer. In an embodiment, a via is formed through a thickness of the substrate. In an embodiment, an organic dielectric layer is provided over the substrate, and the organic dielectric layer has a second edge surface. In an embodiment, a recess is formed into the second edge surface of the organic dielectric layer.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR COOLING VEHICLE AUTONOMY COMPUTING SYSTEM
abstract: A system includes a heat exchanger coupled to a fluid line in thermal communication with an autonomy computing system of a vehicle. The heat exchanger is configured to facilitate heat transfer from fluid in the fluid line to an ambient environment. The system also includes a chiller coupled to the fluid line and configured to remove heat from the fluid when the fluid is directed to the chiller and a bypass connected to the fluid line and extending downstream of the chiller. The system further includes a controller configured to operate a valve to direct the fluid in the fluid passageway to the chiller or to the bypass.

title: ＢＧＡ高周波モジュール、ＢＧＡ高周波モジュール用基板、および光通信モジュール
METHOD OF DIMM COOLING WITH GAS AND INFLATABLE COLD PLATE
abstract: An apparatus for DIMM cooling includes an inflatable cold plate configured for placement in a slot between two memory cards connected to a motherboard of a computing device. The inflatable cold plate expands to contact the two memory cards in response to pressure from a cooling fluid and the inflatable cold plate is configured to transfer heat from the two memory cards to the cooling fluid. The inflatable cold plate is in fluid communication with a fluid pump configured to pump the cooling fluid through the inflatable cold plate at a sufficient pressure to pressurize the inflatable cold plate against the two memory cards and to circulate the cooling fluid through the inflatable cold plate to transfer heat from the inflatable cold plate.

title: SEALABLE COVERS FOR ELECTRICAL DEVICES
abstract: A cover assembly for an electrical device having a housing, a lid, a hinge assembly that pivotably couples the lid to the housing, and a cover seal assembly. The cover seal assembly includes a first sealing tab that extends from the lid and a second sealing tab that extends from the housing. The first and second sealing tabs define apertures that align when the lid is in a closed position and are configured to interact with the cover seal assembly such that the lid is sealed in the closed position.

title: DIRECTLY COOLED INVERTER
abstract: The invention relates to a directly cooled inverter (1) comprising: a cooling circuit (5) for cooling components (2A, 2B, 2C) of the inverter (1); a cooling fluid (7) which at least in part flows through and/or around the components (2A, 2B, 2C) of the inverter (1) and is in direct contact therewith; and at least one sensor (8) which is arranged in the cooling circuit (5), wherein the sensor (8) is designed to detect properties of the cooling fluid (7).

title: 積層体の製造方法、回路配線の製造方法
EnerJet Pro
abstract: The present invention relates to a portable Level 2 electric vehicle charging system that integrates an inverter, a modular lithium-ion battery pack and renewable energy compatibility into a compact, weather-resistant housing. The system is configured to operate with an AC 240-volt supply and to deliver selectable power outputs up to 30 kW for rapid charging. The modular battery design allows scalable storage capacities ranging from 10 kWh to 40 kWh enabling both grid-connected and off-grid charging modes. A control system manages power delivery from the grid, the battery pack or renewable energy sources such as solar or wind through integrated charge controllers. The invention further provides hybrid charging capability, communication interfaces for monitoring and control and optional cooling systems to ensure safe operation. The portable design allows flexibility for residential, commercial and emergency use offering a reliable and scalable solution for electric vehicle charging.

title: MULTILAYER SUBSTRATE
abstract: A multilayer substrate includes: a substrate body formed of resin or ceramic; a hollow portion provided inside the substrate body; a magnet provided inside the hollow portion; and a coil provided around the hollow portion in the substrate body.

title: ストレッチャブルデバイス
DUAL MODE HEATSINK
abstract: A dual mode heatsink includes a base comprising a first surface arranged to receive heat energy from a heat source and a second surface; and cooling fins attached to and extending from the second surface; wherein the base further comprises at least one liquid channel arranged between the first surface and the second surface, the at least one liquid channel being defined by one or more walls forming a heat conducting connection between the first surface and the second surface.

title: ROLL FORMED LIQUID COOLED BUSBAR
abstract: A liquid-cooled roll-formed busbar assembly comprises a sheet of copper or similarly conductive metal roll-formed into at least one arcuate region. One or more cooling pipes of a fluid network (e.g., a coolant supply pipe and a coolant return pipe) circulate a cooling fluid through the busbar such that the arcuate region/s conform to a portion of the external circumference of the cooling pipe/s. A thermal interface is disposed between the cooling pipes and the liquid-cooled roll-formed busbar, such that the circulating fluid absorbs heat from the busbar via the thermal interface and transfers the absorbed heat to a primary fluid network.

title: SEALABLE COVERS FOR ELECTRICAL DEVICES
abstract: A cover assembly for an electrical device having a housing, a lid, a hinge assembly that pivotably couples the lid to the housing, and a cover seal assembly. The cover seal assembly includes a first sealing tab that extends from the lid and a second sealing tab that extends from the housing. The first and second sealing tabs define apertures that align when the lid is in a closed position and are configured to interact with the cover seal assembly such that the lid is sealed in the closed position.

title: EYEWEAR HAVING A PROJECTOR WITH HEAT SINK SHIELDS
abstract: A projector, such as for eyewear, having a first and second shield that individually sink heat from a light source and provide electromagnetic (EM) shielding for the projector, and a processor controlling the projector. The shields sink heat evenly and efficiently, to different portions of the eyewear. In one example, the heat is directed in different directions. The shields encompass the light source and the processor, and they may be parallel to one another. The thickness of the shield coupled to the light source is thicker proximate the light source. The shields may be separated from each other by a thermal insulating material.

title: FLIP APPARATUS AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE
abstract: A flip apparatus includes a first friction component and a second friction component. The first friction component is arranged between a first moving component and a second moving component that move relative to each other. The second friction component is arranged between the second moving component and a third moving component that move relative to each other. The first friction component is different from the second friction component. When the flip apparatus moves from a first status to a second status, and the first friction component and the second friction component jointly provide a damping force.

title: UNGLEICHMÄSSIGE KÜHLRIPPENGEOMETRIE FÜR ERHÖHTE THERMISCHE LEISTUNG
abstract: Gemäß verschiedenen Ausführungsformen beinhaltet eine Wärmesenke: eine Vielzahl von Kühlrippen, wobei eine erste Kühlrippe, die in der Vielzahl von Kühlrippen enthalten ist, einen ersten Abschnitt mit einer ersten Höhe aufweist und einen zweiten Abschnitt mit einer zweiten Höhe aufweist, die geringer als die erste Höhe ist, und wobei die erste Höhe und die zweite Höhe in einer Richtung definiert sind, die parallel zu einer Richtung von Kühlluft ist, die über die Vielzahl von Kühlrippen strömt.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR ADJUSTING PRESSURE IN IMMERSION-COOLED DATACENTERS
abstract: A thermal management system includes a high-pressure (HP) container, a low-pressure (LP) container in fluid communication with the HP container and having a fluid pressure less than the HP container, and a two-phase working fluid partially in the HP container and partially in the LP container. The two-phase working fluid has a vapor phase and a liquid phase. A pump is configured to move the working fluid through the system, and a condenser is configured to condense the vapor phase of the working fluid into the liquid phase.

title: OXYGEN CONCENTRATION DETECTION SYSTEM AND REFLOW OVEN USING THE SAME
abstract: The present application discloses an oxygen concentration detection system for detecting the oxygen concentration in a furnace chamber of a reflow oven, comprising: a cooling device, a filter device, and a detection device. The oxygen concentration detection system of the present application utilizes a semiconductor cooler to condense sample gas within the furnace chamber, thereby removing most of the VOC contaminants in the sample gas. Subsequently, by employing activated carbon adsorption filtration, all contaminants in the gas are basically eliminated, resulting in a more accurate detection result from the detection device. Furthermore, due to the rapid cooling capabilities of the semiconductor cooler and the relatively short sample gas flow distance, the oxygen concentration detection system of the present application is also capable of reducing the required detection time, enabling more timely detection from the detection device. Therefore, the oxygen concentration detection system of the present application is capable of timely and accurately detecting the oxygen concentration in a gas within a reflow oven furnace chamber and adjusting the oxygen content therein according to the detection result, thereby enhancing the soldering quality.

title: Gehäuse für ein Feldgerät der Prozessautomatisierung und Feldgerät
abstract: Die Erfindung bezieht sich auf ein Gehäuse für ein Feldgerät der Prozessautomatisierung. Ein Befestigungshals (1) weist eine Befestigungsstruktur (11) und ein Deckel eine korrespondierte Befestigungsstruktur (21) auf. Der Deckel (2) weist einen Boden (22), eine Wandung (23), die die Befestigungsstruktur (21) trägt, und ein Einlegeteil (3) auf. Das Einlegeteil (3) verfügt über eine Sicherungsstruktur (31), die mit der Befestigungsstruktur (21) des Deckels (2) ein Herausfallen des Einlegeteils (3) aus dem Deckel (2) verhindert.

title: CIRCUIT STRUCTURE AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: A circuit structure and a manufacturing method thereof are provided, in which a seed layer composed of a plurality of discontinuous metal blocks is formed on a dielectric layer, and a circuit layer is formed on the seed layer by electroplating. By roughening the overall surface of the plurality of discontinuous metal blocks and creating a relatively concave-convex structure, the bonding effect between the seed layer and the circuit layer formed thereon is strengthened, thereby preventing the problem of delamination and improving the process yield.

title: Verfahren und Systeme für Transpositionskanal-Routing
abstract: Vorrichtung, die Folgendes umfasst:eine Leiterplatte (PCB) mit einer Anordnung von Kontaktpads;eine Mehrzahl von Signalleitungen, die auf der Leiterplatte angeordnet sind, wobei ein Teil der Mehrzahl von Signalleitungen eine Escape-Route auf der Leiterplatte umfasst;eine Mehrzahl von Routing-Kanälen, wobei jeder Routing-Kanal zwischen einer ersten Reihe Kontaktpads und einer zweiten Reihe Kontaktpads angeordnet ist, wobei jeder Routing-Kanal einen ersten Kanal auf einer ersten Leiterplattenschicht und einen zweiten Transpositionskanal auf einer zweiten Leiterplattenschicht aufweist und wobei ein Paar von Signalleitungen in dem Routing-Kanal geroutet ist; undeine oder mehrere Transpositionsverzweigungen, die innerhalb der Escape-Route angeordnet sind, wobei eine jeweilige Transpositionsverzweigung eine Mehrzahl von Paaren von Vias aufweist, die jeweils in der Mehrzahl von Routing-Kanälen angeordnet sind, und wobei ein jeweiliges Paar von Vias dazu konfiguriert ist, den ersten Kanal auf der ersten Leiterplattenschicht auf solche Weise mit dem entsprechenden zweiten Transpositionskanal auf der zweiten Leiterplattenschicht zu verbinden, dass das entsprechende Paar der Signalleitungen mit vertauschten relativen Positionen von der ersten Leiterplattenschicht zu der zweiten Leiterplattenschicht geführt ist, so dass ein Übersprechen zwischen dem entsprechenden Paar der Signalleitungen reduziert wird.

title: Baustein für Stromrichter
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft einen Baustein für einen Stromrichter, welcher zumindest umfasst einen quaderförmigen Kühlkörper mit Stirnseiten, Längsseiten sowie Ober- und Unterseiten, eine Mehrzahl an der Oberseite des Kühlkörpers nebeneinander angeordnete Leistungshalbleitermodule, welche jeweils als eine Halbbrücke ausgestaltet sind oder zu zumindest einer Halbbrücke verschaltet sind, wobei Modulgehäuse der Leistungshalbleitermodule mit der Oberseite des Kühlkörpers mechanisch und thermisch verbunden sind, und wobei die Modulgehäuse an deren Oberseite jeweils Gleichspannungsanschlüsse und Wechselspannungsanschlüsse aufweisen, eine im Bereich einer ersten Stirnseite des Kühlkörpers angeordnete Mehrzahl Kondensatoren, wobei die Kondensatoren jeweils Teil eines verteilt angeordneten Zwischenkreiskondensators eines Gleichspannungszwischenkreises des Stromrichters sind, erste Stromschienen, welche jeweils Anschlüsse eines der Kondensatoren mit den Gleichspannungsanschlüssen eines der Leistungshalbleitermodule verbinden, wobei eine Ebene für die Verbindung mit den Anschlüssen des Kondensators jeweils senkrecht zu einer Ebene für die Verbindung mit den Gleichspannungsanschlüssen des Leistungshalbleitermoduls und/oder senkrecht zu einer Ebene der Oberseite des Kühlkörpers ausgerichtet ist, und zweite Stromschienen, welche die Gleichspannungsanschlüsse der Leistungshalbleitermodule miteinander verbinden und Gleichspannungsanschlüsse des Bausteins ausbilden, wobei die Gleichspannungsanschlüsse des Bausteins einer Verbindung mit dem Gleichspannungszwischenkreis des Stromrichters dienen, wobei die Gleichspannungsanschlüsse des Bausteins in einem Bereich zumindest einer der Längsseiten des Kühlkörpers angeordnet sind und wobei eine Ebene für die Verbindung mit dem Gleichspannungszwischenkreis senkrecht zu der Ebene der Oberseite und/oder der Längsseite des Kühlkörpers ausgerichtet ist.

title: Wärmeableitungsvorrichtung und Kommunikationsgerät
abstract: Das vorliegende Document betrifft eine Wärmeableitungsvorrichtung und ein Kommunikationsgerät, betriftt das technische Gebiet von Wärmeableitungstechnologie für Gerät. Die Wärmeableitungsvorrichtung darin umfasst eine erste Flüssigkeitskühlungsplatte, eine zweite Flüssigkeitskühlungsplatte, einen ersten Flüssigkeitsverteiler und einen zweiten Flüssigkeitsverteiler. Die erste Flüssigkeitskühlungsplatte ist dazu vorgesehen, an dem Chip anzuliegen, und die erste Flüssigkeitskühlungsplatte umfasst einen ersten inneren Kanal für Strömen von Kühlmedium, um Oberflächenwärme zu entziehen, sowie eine erste Flüssigkeitseintrittsöffnung und eine erste Flüssigkeitsaustrittsöffnung, die mit dem ersten inneren Kanal in Verbindung stehen. Die zweite Flüssigkeitskühlungsplatte ist dazu vorgesehen, an dem optischen Modul anzuliegen und die zweite Flüssigkeitskühlungsplatte umfasst einen zweiten inneren Kanal für Strömen von dem Kühlmedium, um Oberflächenwärme zu entziehen, sowie eine zweite Flüssigkeitseintrittsöffnung und eine zweite Flüssigkeitsaustrittsöffnung, die jeweils mit dem zweiten inneren Kanal in Verbindung stehen. Ein Ende des ersten Flüssigkeitsverteilers steht mit der ersten Flüssigkeitseintrittsöffnung und der zweiten Flüssigkeitseintrittsöffnung in Verbindung, um den ersten inneren Kanal und den zweiten inneren Kanal mit dem Kühlmedium zu versorgen. Die Wärmeableitungsvorrichtung und das Kommunikationsgerät, die durch die Ausführungsbeispiele der vorliegenden Anmeldung bereitgestellt sind, können Wärmeableitungsskapazität für wärmeerzeugende Komponenten erhöhen.

title: ガラスフィラー除去のための水性アルカリ洗浄剤溶液及び方法
ELECTRONIC DEVICE AND MULTI-CONTACT CONNECTOR FOR USE THEREWITH
abstract: A multi-contact connector and an electronic device incorporating same include a base member, first and second sets of electrical contacts, and electrical conduits. The base member defines apertures and includes a first side, a second side, and at least one sidewall. The apertures in the base member are distal from the one or more sidewalls. Electrical contacts of the first set are positioned in the base member apertures such that at least a portion of each electrical contact is exposed on the second side of the base member. Electrical contacts in the second set are positioned on the second side of the base member proximate to the sidewall(s) of the base member. Each electrical conduit couples an electrical contact of the first set to a corresponding electrical contact of the second set to form a pair of coupled contacts. Use of the connector permits a lower profile electronic device.

title: COOLANT DISTRIBUTION UNIT
abstract: A coolant distribution unit includes a housing, a primary flow path, a secondary flow path, a heat exchanger, and an emission path. The primary flow path is housed in the housing and connects a primary inlet and a primary outlet provided in the housing. The secondary flow path is housed in the housing and connects a secondary inlet and a secondary outlet provided in the housing. The heat exchanger is housed in the housing and connected to the primary flow path and the secondary flow path. The emission path is housed in the housing and connects an emission port provided in the housing and the primary flow path or the secondary flow path.

title: HIGH POWER WIRE CONNECTION TO PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD
abstract: A printed circuit board assembly for a vehicle steering system includes a printed circuit board. The printed circuit board assembly also includes a terminal operatively mounted to a surface of the printed circuit board, wherein the terminal is formed of an elastically deformable material, wherein the terminal includes a first spring segment and a second spring segment. The printed circuit board assembly further includes a wire disposed between, and in contact with, the first spring segment and the second spring segment.

title: INVERTED INFORMATION HANDLING SYSTEM
abstract: An information handling system includes a system board and a cooling apparatus. The system board includes an electronic component. The cooling apparatus is to cool the electronic component with a liquid coolant circulated by a cooling distribution unit. The information handling system defines a dry plane, wherein the system board is located above the dry plane, and the cooling apparatus is located below the dry plane adjacent the system board.

title: SLIDE RAIL DEVICE FOR A SERVER RACK
abstract: A slide rail device for connecting with a server case includes a middle rail unit and an inner rail unit. The middle rail unit includes a middle rail and a return abutting member disposed on the middle rail. The inner rail unit includes an inner rail slidable along the middle rail and having an engaging slot, a lock member engageable with an engaging member of the server case inserted into the engaging slot, and a releasing member operably moved to press the lock member away from an inner rail surface of the inner rail so as to release engagement of the lock member from the engaging member. During sliding movement of the inner rail unit relative to the middle rail in a retreating direction, the releasing member is moved to be pressed by the return abutting member to return to an original position thereof.

title: ELECTRONIC CONTROL DEVICE
abstract: An electronic control unit includes a first circuit board, a second circuit, a first connector, a second connector, and a flat cable. The first circuit board and the second circuit board face each other. The first connector is arranged on the first circuit board. The second connector is arranged on the second circuit board. The flat cable electrically connects the first connector and the second connector. At least one circuit element and an auxiliary component are arranged on the second circuit board and positioned directly beneath the flat cable. A height of the auxiliary component is greater than a height of the at least one circuit element. The flat cable is configured to contact the auxiliary component without contacting the at least one circuit element.

title: Multisensor interface für maritime Fahrzeuge
abstract: Um ein Gehäusesystem aufweisend mindestens zwei öffenbare, umschlossene Gehäuse (1, 1') zur Aufnahme elektronischer Komponenten (7), wobei die Gehäuse (1, 1') jeweils eine erste Verbindungsseite (A) mit einer an dieser angeordneten Kupplung (12), wobei die Kupplung (12) mindestens einen abgedichteten Steckverbinder (2) aufweist, und eine zweite Verbindungsseite (B) mit mindestens einem an diesem angeordnetem weiteren Steckverbinder (3) aufweist, wobei zwischen jeweils zwei Gehäusen (1, 1') eine wasserdichte, elektrische Verbindung mittels mechanischer Verbindung der Kupplung (12) des einen Gehäuses (1) mit der zweiten Verbindungsseite (B) des anderen Gehäuses (1') und ein Ineinanderstecken der Steckverbinder (2) des einen Gehäuses (1) und der weiteren Steckverbinder (3) des anderen Gehäuses (1') herstellbar ist, anzugeben, mit dessen Hilfe sämtliche notwendige elektronische Komponenten auf derartigen Fahrzeugen verwendeter externer Geräte, insbesondere Messgeräte und Sonden, modular, einfach, wasserdicht und robust aufbaubar und integrierbar sind, sodass ein einfacher Tausch externer Geräte, aber auch elektronischer Komponenten oder ein einfaches Hinzufügen eines weiteren Gerätes ermöglicht ist, wird vorgeschlagen, dass über die elektrische Verbindung eine Weiterleitung eines Stromsignals (4) und eines Datensignals (5) ermöglicht ist.

title: LAPTOP COOLING VIA LOW-PRESSURE AIR MOVER
abstract: Technical solutions discussed herein include cooling systems for electronic devices, including low-pressure ionic blowers and electromagnetic air movers to improve thermal management in laptops. The cooling system may include multiple blower modules arranged in parallel or series configurations. The thermal solution may be a vapor chamber or a heat pipe, or may include a thin-film air-moving device integrated into an air gap. The cooling system may selectively operate between low pressure blower modules and centrifugal blowers based on cooling demands. The blower module may include an electrode configuration with a single exposed electrode. The cooling system may also incorporate an active noise cancellation system using phase-shifted signals between blower units.

title: CONDUCTIVE FILM AND ELECTROMAGNETIC WAVE SHIELDING MATERIAL USING SAME
abstract: One aspect of the present invention relates to a conductive film including: a thermosetting resin layer; and a conductive layer on at least a part of at least one surface of the thermosetting resin layer, in which the thermosetting resin layer has an elongation at break at 20° C. of 50% or more, a tensile modulus at 20° C. of 1.0 MPa or more and 200 MPa or less, and a storage modulus at 250° C. of 0.1 MPa or more and 200 MPa or less, a film thickness of the conductive layer is 0.1 μm or more and 3.0 μm or less, the conductive layer contains a metal complex, and the conductive layer has a surface resistivity of 1×10−2Ω/□ or more and 10 Ω/□ or less.

title: MODULAR RADIATOR ASSEMBLY AND AIR-TO-LIQUID COOLING CABINET USING SAME
abstract: MODULAR RADIATOR ASSEMBLY AND AIR-TO-LIQUID COOLING CABINET USING SAME A modular radiator assembly and an air-to-liquid cooling cabinet using the same are disclosed. The radiator assembly includes a housing, a heat exchanger module, two fan sets. The housing includes an air inlet, an air outlet, an upper wall, a lower wall and two lateral walls, and an accommodation space is in communication between the air inlet and the air outlet. The heat exchanger module is connected to the upper wall, the lower wall and the two lateral walls. The heat exchanger module is accommodated in the accommodation space obliquely relative to the lower wall. The two fan sets are connected between the two lateral walls, and disposed adjacent to the air inlet or the air outlet. An airflow generated by the two fan sets is inhaled through the air inlet, flows through the heat exchanger module, and is discharged from the air outlet. MODULAR RADIATOR ASSEMBLY AND AIR-TO-LIQUID COOLING CABINET USING SAME A modular radiator assembly and an air-to-liquid cooling cabinet using the same are disclosed. The radiator assembly includes a housing, a heat exchanger module, two fan sets. The housing includes an air inlet, an air outlet, an upper wall, a lower wall and two lateral walls, and an accommodation space is in communication between the air inlet and the air outlet. The heat exchanger module is connected to the upper wall, the lower wall and the two lateral walls. The heat exchanger module is accommodated in the accommodation space obliquely relative to the lower wall. The two fan sets are connected between the two lateral walls, and disposed adjacent to the air inlet or the air outlet.
